title: Private native Agent IPC and OpenMath canonical messages
description: Shape is not permission. Host owns connection/task/document/grants and admission IDs. Credentials and arbitrary transport URLs are not frame fields. UTF8 NDJSON frames are at most 1MiB; immutable canonical events require durable ACK. Helper settled is loop state, not proof of mathematical/task success.

Serial.description: 共同可精确表示的单调计数；不能静默回绕。

result_json.description: Exact bounded native tool-result envelope, read back from its durable Blob before delivery; canonical messages retain result_ref only.

CellIdentity.description: 源码单元格ID沿用.omnb v1的非空文本；按原UTF8区分，不作为路径或operation身份。

OperationReceipt.description: 幂等事实保留；终止状态转移、操作归属及参数散列由宿主验证，不以 expired token 代替 ledger ID。
OperationReceipt.x-implementation-status: partial: actual source transactions; other operations/admission/grants registered later
